decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk system fits growing ergonomic office demand, its prospects are still uncertain after only one year, and its own page signals commitment, so the option is worth keeping open.
A chair family is close to the core furniture business and cheap to keep in the portfolio, and one year of evidence is too little to abandon it.

Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche, more experimental option with uncertain demand, but they cost little to keep, so the firm waits for clearer results despite a higher risk of being dropped.

The sofa is only mentioned rather than presented on its own page, which suggests weaker commitment, but as a young option with low holding costs it is kept for now with an elevated chance of being dropped.
A high standing table complements the desk and office line at low incremental cost, and its value is still unresolved, so keeping it open is sensible.
A rug collection lies further from the core furniture business and its uncertainty is still high, but its own page and low holding cost justify keeping the option another year.
